name: Bloody Chronicles - New Cycle of Death
source:
A serial killer is on the loose and only you can stop the Phantom! The story focuses on Kazuki, a young detective employed by Igrasil, an agency that investigates murders that the authorities have deemed unsolvable. While working on several, seemingly unrelated cases, you find clues pointing to the person who killed your parents.
Can you stop this new cycle of death before it's too late?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/455310/Bloody_Chronicles__New_Cycle_of_Death_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
连环杀手逍遥法外，只有你能阻止幻影！故事围绕年轻侦探一树展开，他受雇于伊格德拉希尔事务所，调查当局认定无法侦破的谋杀案。在处理几起看似毫无关联的案件时，你发现线索指向杀害自己父母的人。

在为时已晚前，你能阻止这场新的死亡循环吗？

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/455310/Bloody_Chronicles__New_Cycle_of_Death_Visual_Novel/]Steam[/url]]
